## Où j'en suis
PR #418 (grid v2) is merged, and #401 (visx) is closed with recharts kept. The follow-up PR #423 (keyboard move/resize with `useGridKeyboard`, plus a focus ring) is open and awaiting Priya's review, committed as 8f1a2c7. `dashboards_v2` is on for zest-grocers on staging, and production is untouched. (source: ses-db-4, kestrel-analytics/platform#423, kestrel-analytics/platform#418)

- [en-cours] PR #423 is open, with Priya requested as reviewer and 11 new tests green. (source: kestrel-analytics/platform#423, d4-05)
- [prochaine-étape] Priya rehearses the Zest demo on staging, then Tom flips the production flag himself the morning of Tuesday the 24th. (source: d4-06, b2-04)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit `KeyboardSensor` on react-grid-layout applied every move twice and fired two layout changes per mouse drag. Making them cooperate would mean rewriting the grid, so it was removed. (source: d4-02, d4-04)
- [décision] Use our own keyboard handler on top of the layout state, with no dnd-kit. (source: d4-04)
- [décision] Close #401 and keep recharts: no second chart library, and no time to rewrite 9 charts. (source: c3-03)
- [décision] The production flag is on ONLY for the Zest workspace, and the old dashboards stay behind the flag until January. (source: b2-04)
